ctbids-48925-5696648.description:
Item Description:
Up for auction is a charming, authentic pair of vintage weighted sterling silver candlestick holders. Featuring a timeless mid-century silhouette, these holders boast a classic gadroon or rope-twist decorative border along both the top rim and the flared base. They add an elegant, traditional touch to any holiday table setting, mantelpiece, or vintage silver collection.
As is standard for this type of fine hollowware, they are "weighted" or "reinforced" with an internal compound (such as plaster or cement) at the base to provide excellent structural stability and prevent tipping when holding tall taper candles.
Condition Report:
These items are in honest vintage condition and are being sold exactly as found, showcasing a deep, authentic aged patina and tarnish. There are minor surface scratches and small, typical pin-dent imperfections consistent with age, handling, and gentle use over the decades. One of the candlesticks has the silver skin at the neck area coming slightly apart.  They have not been heavily cleaned or chemically polished, allowing the winning bidder to decide whether to preserve the historic character or polish them to a bright, mirrored shine.
